claims.statement: Employed at the court of Ludovico Sforza. Presence in Milan is documented from the 1483 Virgin of the Rocks contract. The date of arrival is not recorded.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Contract of 25 April 1483; court and cathedral records.
